age.evidence: Placental samples were obtained from 44 patients with singleton pregnancies, aged 19–40 and gestational ages ranging from 35–42 weeks based on the dating criteria from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28426621/) for women who delivered vaginally or by cesarean delivery (CD), between 7 AM to 4 PM, based on obstetric indications (Table 1).
The demographic Supplementary Table 20 shows that 91% of study participants were 18–34 years old and 75% were multiparous.

cell_type.evidence: Immunogold electron microscopy showed VEGFR2 on endothelial cell (EC) nuclei, mitochondria, and Hofbauer cells (HC), tissue-resident macrophages of the placenta.
keywords: Vegfr2; Placenta; Hofbauer cells; Mdmx; Trim21; Picalm; Oxytocin receptor; Proteomics
Immunogold electron microscopy showed VEGFR2 on endothelial cell (EC) nuclei, mitochondria, and Hofbauer cells (HC), tissue-resident macrophages of the placenta.

developmental_stage.evidence: The study of the VEGFR2 proteome of chorionic villi at term revealed its partners MDMX (Double minute 4 protein) and PICALM (Phosphatidylinositol-binding clathrin assembly protein).

disease_state.evidence: Preeclampsia was diagnosed according to the criteria established in 2013 by ACOG (10.1097/01.AOG.0000437382.03963.88).
